simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לִוְיָה (H3880) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: לִוְיָה (livyâh) means something attached , i.e. a wreath First listed occurrence: Prov 1 9.

definitions.full: H3880. livyah [ לִוְיָה ] noun feminine wreath ; — construct חֵן לִוְיַת only figurative Prov 1:9 (|| עֲנָקִים ) of instruction of parents, 4:9 (|| תִּפְאֶרֶת עֲטֶרֶת ) of work of Wisdom.
